name: content
description: Content rendered inside the tooltip popup.

name: children
description: Trigger element. Must be a single element that accepts a ref.

name: side
description: Side of the trigger the tooltip appears on.

name: showArrow
description: Whether to render the directional arrow pointing at the trigger.

name: defaultOpen
description: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage.

name: onOpenChange
description: Called when the open state changes.

name: disabled
description: Disables the tooltip entirely — no hover or focus triggers.

name: className
description: Additional class applied to the popup element.
